nodes.label: wWinMain / main()
nodes.desc: Entry point for Windows (wWinMain) and Linux/macOS/FreeBSD (main): init framework, register signal handlers, start server async, then start app.

nodes.label: __initFramework()
nodes.desc: resources::init, settings::init, authbasic::init, permission::init, storage::init plus systemEnvs injection in strict order.

nodes.label: __startServerAsync()
nodes.desc: Starts the local server when enableServer is set; catches websocketpp exceptions and shows a native error dialog on failure.

nodes.label: __startApp()
nodes.desc: Switches on AppMode: window (webview), chrome (attached Google Chrome), browser (system browser) or cloud; tryFallbackModes walks the chain.

nodes.label: neuserver::init()
nodes.desc: Wires websocketpp handlers, binds 127.0.0.1 (0.0.0.0 in cloud mode), supports port 0 ephemeral binding and writes the actual port back via settings::setPort.

nodes.label: startAsync()
nodes.desc: Runs server->run() on a detached thread so the asio event loop never blocks the main thread.

nodes.label: handleValidate()
nodes.desc: Rejects upgrades from non-localhost hosts, URLs without a connectToken, bad tokens, and unloaded extension ids.

nodes.label: handleMessage()
nodes.desc: Parses {id, method, accessToken, data} JSON frames, tracks text/binary wsMode per connection, and sends the router response back on the same socket.

nodes.label: handleHTTP()
nodes.desc: Prefixes documentRoot, extracts Range headers into fs::FileReaderOptions, calls router::serve and applies configured serverHeaders.

nodes.label: handleConnect/Disconnect
nodes.desc: Keeps appConnections (set) and extConnections (map by extensionId) and dispatches appClientConnect / clientDisconnect events with live counts.

nodes.label: __exitProcessIfIdle()
nodes.desc: After the last app client disconnects in browser or chrome mode, a detached 10-second timer calls app::exit() if nobody reconnects.

nodes.label: executeNativeMethod()
nodes.desc: Token and permission gates, window-mode guard for window.* methods, and on macOS dispatch_sync to the main queue for UI calls.

nodes.label: methodMap (127 methods)
nodes.desc: Static map from method strings like app.exit, window.setTitle, filesystem.readFile, os.execCommand to controller function pointers.

nodes.label: router::serve()
nodes.desc: URL-decodes paths, strips query strings, and special-cases neutralino.js and __neutralino_globals.js which get global variables injected.

nodes.label: getAsset()
nodes.desc: Extension-based MIME table, singlePageServe fallback to index.html, 206 partial-content responses with Accept-Ranges and Content-Range headers.

nodes.label: mountPath()/getMounts()
nodes.desc: Backs the server.mount / server.unmount API: maps virtual URL prefixes onto real filesystem directories.

nodes.label: authbasic::init()
nodes.desc: helpers::generateToken() builds a 96-character token from a 64-symbol alphabet with a dot injected at index 47; the part after the dot becomes the connectToken.

nodes.label: getToken()
nodes.desc: With tokenSecurity=one-time the access token is returned once and then wiped, so global-variable injection only leaks it to the first page load.

nodes.label: verifyToken/verifyConnectToken
nodes.desc: Plain string equality against the startup-generated secrets, used by the WebSocket validate handler and the native method router.

nodes.label: hasMethodAccess()
nodes.desc: Checks nativeBlockList or nativeAllowList, expanding module wildcards like os.* into module-level rules; no list means everything is allowed.

nodes.label: hasFileSystemPathAccess()
nodes.desc: filesystemScopes map paths to read/write rights; candidate paths are resolved with weakly_canonical and must sit inside the scope directory.

nodes.label: Neutralino.app
nodes.desc: exit, killProcess, getProcessId, getConfig, broadcast and stdin/stdout process bridges for spawned children.

nodes.label: Neutralino.window
nodes.desc: setTitle, move, setSize, setFullScreen, beginDrag, snapshot, setMainMenu and more; discarded outside window mode by the router.

nodes.label: Neutralino.filesystem
nodes.desc: Read/write files and directories, watchers, stats, path helpers, chmod/chown; every path flows through filesystemScopes checks.

nodes.label: Neutralino.os
nodes.desc: execCommand and spawnProcess gated by commandAllowList patterns, plus env vars, dialogs, notifications, tray and os.open.

nodes.label: Neutralino.computer
nodes.desc: Hardware introspection: memory, CPU, kernel, OS, GPUs, displays, disks, network interfaces, mouse position and hostname.

nodes.label: Neutralino.storage
nodes.desc: setData, getData, removeData, getKeys and clear over per-key files in the app data directory.

nodes.label: Neutralino.events
nodes.desc: events.broadcast plus the dispatch engine used for clientConnect, appClientConnect and extClientConnect lifecycle events.

nodes.label: Neutralino.extensions
nodes.desc: dispatch, broadcast and getStats towards extension processes connected over WebSocket with their own extensionId.

nodes.label: clipboard/net/custom/server/res/debug
nodes.desc: Remaining modules: clipboard read/write, net.request over libcurl, custom registered methods, server mounts, resource extraction and debug.log.

nodes.label: resources::init()
nodes.desc: Tries embedded mode first, then resources.neu bundle, then plain directory; getModeString() reports directory, bundle or embedded.

nodes.label: __seekFilePos()/__makeBundleFileTree()
nodes.desc: Reads the 8-byte size header, parses the JSON file tree at offset 16, and walks path segments to find each file's size and offset.

nodes.label: __getFileFromEmbedded()
nodes.desc: Locates the NEUTRALINOJS_RESOURCES_NEU payload in the executable via postject_find_resource and slices bytes at asarHeaderSize + offset + pos.

nodes.label: __getFileFromBundle()
nodes.desc: Opens resources.neu with ifstream and seekg(asarHeaderSize + uOffset + pos) to read individual files without extracting the archive.
